attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb 11.4.12 + galera 26.4.13) on node1/node2/node3 (Alpine 3.23), loaded it with committed application data (appdb.orders), performed a full clean maintenance-window shutdown of all three members, and brought the cluster back up with every committed write intact and all three members Synced/Primary again. Additionally executed the mandatory per-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id baselines, restarted node1/node2/node3 one at a time via native reboot while preserving quorum, confirmed each node's boot_id changed post-restart, and verified each node auto-rejoined Galera (wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced) with the application data fully present afterward.
